title: schema-check: certificates for canonical JSON completion
description: Inspect JSON Schema constraints using a supported canonical UTF-8 reference language. The tools compute emptiness and shortest byte completions with separate checking entries, provide fixed-vocabulary token certificates, and retain finite probes of pinned external backends. Project code is Apache-2.0; original documentation/generated data are CC-BY-4.0; third-party terms are retained separately. No formal certification, general JSON Schema coverage or arbitrary sampling termination is claimed. No DOI is specified.
